title: The outer decode of a bash -c wrapper does not apply bash double-quote escapes
outcome: engram_unwrap_shell_command decodes a bash -c wrapper's outer words the way the outer bash does: inside double quotes, a backslash escapes only $, `, ", \ and a newline. The script it returns is then the one bash runs.
acceptance: The outer decode of a bash -c wrapper does not apply bash double-quote escapes is done
disposal_reason: Moot under Termal::Fable2's fallback ruling (TermAl mailbox d84e975b #125). From w-a702b21c18b1 R12 (70ea2fcd) on, a Claude Bash line that launches through a bash -c wrapper is refused with a recorded reason and is not decoded. Modelling the bash -c outer double-quote escapes, along with the other wrapper forms, is now part of w-b10f64109a9d.
